in_marathi.name: Khilesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Fortress
in_marathi.long_meaning: Khilesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Khilesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Khila' which means fortress or stronghold. This name is believed to be given to a child who is destined to become a protector, a leader, and a strong-willed individual. In Hindu mythology, Khilesh is also the name of a king who ruled over the kingdom of Haihayas.
